name: Radequinil
summary: Radequinil (INN; AC-3933) is a cognitive enhancer which acts as a partial inverse agonist of the benzodiazepine site of the GABAA receptor. It was under development by Dainippon Sumitomo Pharma for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease and made it to phase II clinical trials but development seems to have been halted and it was never marketed.

pharmacology.text: Radequinil (INN; AC-3933) is a cognitive enhancer which acts as a partial inverse agonist of the benzodiazepine site of the GABAA receptor.

uses.text: It was under development by Dainippon Sumitomo Pharma for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease and made it to phase II clinical trials but development seems to have been halted and it was never marketed.

fact.en: Radequinil does the opposite of a benzodiazepine at the same site on the GABA-A receptor. Weakening that calming signal was the idea behind testing it as a memory drug.
fact.zh: Radequinil 在 GABA-A 受體的同一個位點上，作用和苯二氮平相反。削弱這個抑制訊號，正是把它當作記憶藥物試驗的構想。
